title: RIG · 4× RTX 3090
description: Scroll-driven interactive presentation of a real 4× RTX 3090 open-air rig. The 3D model was built by Claude Fable 5.1 in Blender from photographs (673 objects: aluminium frame, four triple-fan GPUs with perforated brackets, motherboard with risers, tower cooler, RGB fans, two PSUs, cables and improvised stands), exported to Draco-compressed glTF and staged in Three.js with PBR lighting, shadows and selective bloom. Scrolling explodes the rig into components, flies the camera through close-ups with captions, then reassembles it; scrolling back reverses the animation.
